comment_regular: DDS/BMP/TGA direct-to-render texture loader. Uses d3dx9_27 D3DXGetImageInfoFromFileInMemory and D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemory. DDS mip-skip fast path only understands FourCC DXT1-DXT5; DX10/BC7 cannot be accepted here without replacing/hooking the loader and decoding/transcoding before D3D9 texture creation.
